_doc: The Index (collection book). sections: what each tab collects. `reference` = how many entries count as 100% for sections whose content is endless (rarities beyond the hand-made tiers, generated mutations, bosses are listed as bonus entries once found). `lockedPreview` = how many undiscovered silhouettes to show after the last found entry in an endless section. rewards[section] and rewards.all: each completion step is granted exactly once (ledger state.index.claimed), reward spec = level-reward spec (rollPrices, freeRolls, backpack, luckPct, gear, ...). Add a section by adding it here and teaching sim/index.js how to list it.

items.name: Items
items.blurb: Every kind of item you have owned.

rarities.name: Rarities
rarities.blurb: Every rarity you have found. They never end.

mutations.name: Mutations
mutations.blurb: Every mutation you have seen on an item.

monsters.name: Monsters
monsters.blurb: Every kind of monster that attacked your base.

bosses.name: Bosses
bosses.blurb: Every boss you have faced. New ones forever.
